title: Klint Kubiak on Fernando Mendoza: I don’t expect him to be perfect right now

sources.title: Klint Kubiak on Fernando Mendoza: I don’t expect him to be perfect right now
sources.description: While the Raiders drafted Fernando Mendoza to be their quarterback of the future, they also signed Kirk Cousins so that Mendoza doesn't have to be QB1 to start the season.
